KaTeX 0.16.8, MIT (see LICENSE), https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX
Files taken unchanged from the npm package katex@0.16.8 (dist/ and
dist/contrib/auto-render.min.js). Served locally, so that no visitor is
sent to a third-party CDN. Used by templates/emerald/header.tpl to render
$...$ and $$...$$ formulas, which the Markdown module leaves untouched.
